author: jaffar21
install_msg: Thanks for installing F1 Trivia! Use [p]f1trivia start to kick off a game. First to 10 points wins. Good luck!
short: Formula 1 trivia game — first to 10 points wins, 15 seconds per question.
description: A fast-paced Formula 1 trivia cog covering every era of the sport. Each round lasts 15 seconds and the first person to type the correct answer earns a point. First player to reach 10 points wins the game. Covers drivers, teams, circuits, records, and history from the 1950s all the way to today. Answers are flexible — nicknames, first names, last names, and abbreviations are all accepted.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any end user data.
